name: Drow Shootist

items.name: Repeating Hand Crossbow
items.description: This handheld crossbow features an ingeniously designed catch mechanism at the top of the flight groove, just in front of the latch, which automatically loads a bolt from a magazine and resets the string each time the weapon is fired. A typical repeating hand crossbow magazine holds five bolts.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

items.name: Shootist Bandolier
items.description: This leather bandolier holds up to three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines} in leather pockets that pop open with the quick flick of a thumb. You reduce the reload time for a repeating hand crossbow magazine from the bandolier by 1, to a total of 2 actions. You can wear only one shootist bandolier at a time.

generalAbilities.name: Light Blindness
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

When first exposed to bright light, the monster is Blinded until the end of its next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind the monster again until after it spends 1 hour in darkness. However, as long as the monster is in an area of bright light, it's Dazzled.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

defensiveAbilities.name: Shootist's Luck
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The shootist fails a save

Frequency once per day

Effect The shootist rerolls the save and uses the better result.

offensiveAbilities.name: Distracting Shot
offensiveAbilities.description: The shootist takes aim and makes a ranged Strike. If the attack hits and deals damage, the target is Off-Guard until the end of the shootist's turn, or until the end of the shootist's next turn on a critical hit.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reloading Trick
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The shootist is holding an unloaded repeating hand crossbow

Effect The shootist Interacts to reload the repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shootist's Draw
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The shootist Interacts to draw a repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it, or Strikes with a loaded repeating hand crossbow they're holding then Interacts to stow it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The shootist deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

cantrips.name: Dancing Lights
cantrips.description: You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

lv2spells.name: Darkness (At Will)
lv2spells.description:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as Concealed.

lv2spells.name: Faerie Fire (At Will)
lv2spells.description: All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be Concealed while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are Invisible, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being Undetected.
